summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. files Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Shareholders Meeting held June 29, 2026, in Valencia, Spain. The meeting voted on eight routine proposals: election of eight directors, ratification of TAAD, LLP as independent auditor, approval of annual accounts, management report, and results allocation for FY2025, as well as execution powers and meeting minutes. All proposals received over 99.5% support from a quorum of 64.04% of shares present. This is a routine governance update with no special-situations elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes.
